name: sol-advisor
description: Codex-native selective routing: Sol / High keeps judgment-heavy implementation and delegates bounded work to Luna / High by default.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol / High, declare a risk-gated route, and use at most one auxiliary by default.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-6 Sol / High in the primary session for architecture, judgment-heavy or high-risk implementation, verification, and acceptance. Before the first task tool call, Sol declares a machine-auditable SELECTIVE ROUTE: solo is the default; delegate uses native GPT-6 Luna / High for bounded work and GPT-6 Luna / Max only for fully specified deep technical work; audit uses a fresh read-only GPT-6 Sol / High review; full combines one bounded implementer with a fresh review only for a broad or high-risk exception. Public role metadata is authoritative and missing, conflicting, unavailable, or unobservable routing evidence fails closed.
defaultPrompt: Use $sol-advisor:orchestration to declare a SELECTIVE ROUTE before task tools, then build and verify this feature.
Use solo by default; select delegate, audit, or exceptional full only when the stated risk justifies it.
